annotations.title: Compare Thai visas side by side

description: Use this when someone compares two to four Thai visas or routes, or asks which is better or worth it: "Thailand Elite visa vs LTR", "LTR vs retirement visa", "DTV vs Thailand Elite", "DTV vs tourist visa", "Non-O vs O-A", "is the Thailand Privilege card worth it compared with a retirement visa", "cheapest way to stay in Thailand for 10 years", "retirement visa or Elite visa for a couple". Returns for each route: length, minimum age, money test, work rights, family, insurance, reporting, where to apply, and the government cost over the chosen number of years (fees and published Thailand Privilege prices; agent fees not included), with sources. Routes: exempt (30-day visa exemption), tr (tourist visa), dtv (DTV, digital nomad visa), nono (retirement visa: Non-O, O-A, O-X), marriage (Thai spouse or child), ltr (LTR 10-year visa), privilege (Thailand Privilege, formerly Thailand Elite), education (ED visa), work (Non-B and work permit), pr (permanent residence), tdac (arrival card), evisa (Thai e-Visa), reporting (90-day report, TM30, re-entry permit). Do not use for a single route (thai_visa_details) or to rank all routes for a person (which_thai_visa). Not legal advice.

age.description: Optional age: flags routes with an age limit (retirement routes need 50 or over).

routes.description: Two to four routes as the user names them, e.g. ["Thailand Elite", "LTR"] or ["DTV", "retirement visa"].

name: compare_thai_visas

scope.description: answered, compared, or needs_input (then ask the user "question" first).
